verdict: Uses ONLY real components and attributes: bl-input (name, type=email/password, label, required) and bl-button (type=submit) all match the real CEM API, so there are no hallucinated API members and the email/password inputs correctly hide typed text via type=password. However the form has onsubmit='return false;' with no submit handler, so the core requirement — submitting when the user presses Enter or clicks 'Log in' — is not actually wired (no real submit action fires). Button styling relies on class='primary', which is cosmetic rather than the real variant='primary' attribute, though primary is the default variant so appearance is acceptable.
